name: snote-monorepo
description: SNOTE – Second Brain cho Sinh viên (Full-stack Monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run prisma:migrate --prefix backend && npm run prisma:seed --prefix backend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
